text: The tentacle attacks, narrowly missing Hadrian.
The party attacks a Gibbering Mouther in the Yawning Portal, dealing damage and hindering its attacks.
Kallisar attempts to transform his weapon into a shield but fails, then casts Hellish Rebuke, damaging a tentacle.
Victor throws five javelins at the Gibbering Mouther, hitting three times for a total of 16 damage.
Hadrian analyzes the Gibbering Mouther and identifies its weaknesses, relaying the information to the party.
Sigfried casts Sleep, causing the Gibbering Mouther to fall asleep.
Hadrian kills the Gibbering Mouther with his shortsword.
Sigfried casts Mage Hand to grope Durnan and Light on Hadrian's weapon.
Victor threatens Durnan about the monster.
Kallisar casts Expeditious Retreat.
Kallisar examines the Gibbering Mouther's corpse, identifying residual magical energy.
Hadrian insults Victor and questions Durnan about the frequency of monster attacks.
Sigfried attempts to charm Durnan, but Durnan resists the charm.
Victor does pushups.
Kallisar attempts to find usable components on the Gibbering Mouther corpse but finds nothing.
Hadrian asks Durnan if they met his standards; Durnan is unimpressed.
Sigfried asks Durnan about quests and prizes; Durnan says they are earned, not given.
Victor attempts to impress Durnan with his physique, but Durnan is unimpressed and tells him to put his armor back on.
Kallisar asks Durnan to cook the Gibbering Mouther, Durnan refuses.
Sigfried asks Durnan for a quest; Durnan says quests are earned.
Hadrian buys Durnan a round of drinks.
Victor does pushups.
The party attempts to recruit adventurers and impress a dwarf named Bruenor at the Yawning Portal.
Sigfried heals Victor for 10 hit points using Cure Wounds.
Kallisar attempts to persuade others to join the party.
Victor scans the tavern, looking for someone.
Durnan asks if the party is going down the well.
Kallisar waits for her enchantment to take hold.
Victor attempts to recruit a squire but is reminded to roll for persuasion.
Sigfried leaves the tavern to urinate on the building.
Hadrian asks Bruenor about his experience.
Sigfried challenges Bruenor to an Indian leg wrestle.
Hadrian attempts to recruit Bruenor.
Victor attempts to recruit a stablehand.
Kallisar attempts to sway the Yawning Portal's patrons with honeyed words.
Sigfried attempts to charm a youth, but the youth resists the enchantment.
Hadrian attempts to negotiate with Bruenor for proof of the quest's worth.
Victor and Kallisar attempt to recruit a youth with warnings and cursed trinkets.
Sigfried attempts to persuade a youth named Willum, Victor interrupts with an energy drink, and Hadrian attempts to gain information about Willum's map.
Sigfried drops a torch down the well to gauge its depth.
Kallisar attempts to gather information from the bartender about secret entrances to the dungeon.
Hadrian compares Willum's map with Bruenor and tells a humorous story.
Victor attempts to intimidate Willum into joining the quest.
Kallisar attempts to bribe the bartender for information about the tunnels.
Hadrian listens to Willum and Bruenor's conversation.
Sigfried drinks an ale.
Victor questions Willum about his opinion of adventurers.
Victor clarifies the meaning of a racial slur and questions Willum about its use.
Sigfried attempts to jump on Willum's back for a piggyback ride but fails.
Kallisar bribes the barkeep with a magical bathroom key for information about tunnels.
Hadrian asks Bruenor to accompany the party to the docks, and Bruenor agrees.
Kallisar successfully uses Persuasion to get a lead on Fingers Finnigan, who may know about the smuggler tunnels.
Victor Saltzpyre directs Willum to shout a racial slur, creating tension within the party and confusion for Willum.
Sigfried attempts to intimidate Willum with a threat of a 'wet willie'.
Victor Saltzpyre attempts to attack Willum in an alley, creating a tense situation.
[Monster turn] enemies acted (round 1).
